summary: Frontend E2E of new Precio Variable feature in Clinic POS (/punto-venta) + Optica regression. 6 of 7 requested items PASS. Toggle shows up, price input works, total recalculates right away, valid sale saves precio_variable=true / precio_lista=100 / precio_unitario=150, works with the % discount (300-10%=270), detail/ticket show only the charged price, Optica POS unchanged. FAIL: the frontend cost rule never fires (no red border, no 'menor al costo' label, no pre-check toast) because /api/ventas/productos does not return precio_compra. The sale is still blocked, but only by the backend 400, whose message reaches the user as a toast. Also found: turning the toggle OFF keeps the edited price, which skips the cost check completely.

critical.issue: ProductoPOSResponse (routes/ventas.py ~L118) has no precio_compra field, so the POS gets precio_compra=undefined and sets it to 0. Because of that the client-side cost validation, the red border and the 'menor al costo' label never trigger.

minor.issue: Cost validation runs only when item.precio_variable is true. The backend accepts any precio_unitario when precio_variable=false (it never checks it against producto.precio_venta), so a client can sell below cost/list price by sending precio_variable=false.

ui_bugs.component: PuntoVenta cart row - precio variable input
ui_bugs.issue: Typed 40 for a product with cost 60: the border stayed amber and 'menor al costo' did not appear. Root cause: the item's precio_compra is 0 (missing from the API).

Turning the toggle OFF does not put precio_unitario back to precio_lista. Repro: toggle ON, type 20 (cost 60), toggle OFF. The cart shows Q20 at a fixed price and the payload sends precio_variable=false with precio_unitario=20, so neither the frontend nor the backend checks cost. Fix: when toggling off, set precio_unitario=precio_lista and recalculate subtotal.
Clearing the input turns the price into 0 (the total shows Q0.00). For products with cost 0 a Q0 line can be sold. Consider requiring a price > 0.

integration_issues.issue: The frontend pre-check in confirmarVenta (L593) is never reached because precio_compra=0. The block happens only through the backend 400 ('El precio de 'X' no puede ser menor al costo (60.0)'), shown as a toast. The user still gets blocked, but a POST is made, and the cost text is formatted as '60.0' instead of currency.

action_items: Add precio_compra: float = 0 to ProductoPOSResponse and fill it (p.get('precio_compra', 0)) in /ventas/productos and /ventas/productos-rapidos, so the red border, the 'menor al costo' label and the client pre-check work
In togglePrecioVariable, when turning OFF, reset precio_unitario to precio_lista and recalculate subtotal
Optional: in the backend, when precio_variable=false, force precio_unitario = producto.precio_venta (or validate it)
Optional: block an empty or 0 variable price
critical_code_review_comments: The frontend cost rule depends on a field the POS product endpoints never return
Toggle-off leaves a modified price marked as non-variable, which bypasses the cost check and hides the variable-price audit trail
PuntoVenta.js is 2011 lines and should be split

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 requested checks pass; cost-rule UI fails)

Detail: btn-ventas-hoy, then a row, then the 'Detalle de Venta' dialog. The ticket API GET /api/ventas/{id}/ticket returns only cantidad/nombre/precio_unitario/descuento/subtotal (OK). Optica POS has no pv-precio-variable elements (OK).
rca of the issue: agregarAlCarrito reads producto.precio_compra || 0, but the products come from GET /api/ventas/productos with response_model=ProductoPOSResponse, which drops precio_compra. So item.precio_compra is always 0 and every frontend check of item.precio_unitario < item.precio_compra is false. Backend validation still uses the DB value, so it blocks correctly.
